blobs.final: vocr6-lead's message 'FINAL BLOBS S=<path> N=<path> L=<path>' (the blobs to ship: stage 4b's seed-1 fold-in runs, their 4a siblings where 4b's check fails, or VOCR5 where 4a does not adopt VOCR6). blobs.hval_reader: tier T's hval units are read by a recognizer that never trained on them: the final blob when its training held no hval page (a 4a or VOCR5 blob); for a stage-4b blob (trained on train + guard + hval pages: stages.4.4b), its stage-4a sibling of the same tier and seed (hval out), as vocr6/experiments.jsonl records it. blobs.cascade: S -> N -> L with the final blobs (dev and counter set) and with the hval readers (hval): the job's next tier reads the same crop

Commands: eval/vocr6_lm.py dev-cache / hval-cache (#141) and eval/vocr6_final_lm.py counter-cache

line_path: Rubi_for_vita core/vocr_ocr.c finish_line as eval/vocr6_lm.py models it: a line read as empty stays empty; else the counter re-decode (tau, open) of the top-8, the beam (8) + LM decode of the edited top-8 at the setting, the counter text rule (vocr_post_counters); the cascade: a line whose greedy confidence (conf_min x 1000 + 0.5, truncated) is under the threshold shows the next tier's reading of the same crop, decoded by the same steps at the same setting (the job's setting); L has no cascade. Then what Rubi shows: eval/vocr6_lm.RubiShow (core/textnorm.c of Rubi main bd130a8 = cbaa4e3, sha256 3fa19017..., flags 0, then the Shell's non-Japanese line filter)

sets.dev: VOCR5's development cohorts as eval/vocr6_lm.py dev_units builds them (#127): tv (teacher_val's development part) and dn (devnative's four development files) in both views, wd (tv_dlg + dn_dlg through the C GRAD finder and with the refinement), without v12188 (hooked train title PCSG00576) and v18432 (hooked test title PCSG00807); clusters = VNs
sets.hval: vocr6-lm's hval_rubi units (#127; private/vocr6-lm/hval_rubi units.pkl sha256 d81af587..., crops.pkl 56bb4400...): hc 3,170 verified dialogue lines as clean crops, hp 12,654 whole-dialogue region reads (6,327 regions through GRAD and GRAD + refine), 46 hooked train titles' hval pages (PSP in the Adrenaline 2x view); clusters = titles
sets.counter: #109's synthetic counter set (artifacts/kanum-fix/synth/synth.npz, eval/kanum_dev.py render): 3,969 crops = 189 lines of synth3's development text pools (pools3/*.dev.txt) with a numeral before ヶヵケ箇 + 月所年国条, each as 「…」, bare and …」 in one of nine open fonts, each cut 7 ways (left edge 3 px before the ink, at it, 2-10 px into it); the reference is the whole text; clusters = the 189 source lines

metric.cer: dialogue CER (eval/metrics.norm on both sides; names are a secondary column): tv/dn per line over both views; wd and hp per region (the found lines' texts joined in reading order against the region's lines joined); hc per line; the counter set per crop
metric.objective: 0.5 hp + 0.5 dev score (#127's), on the job path of the tier: S with its cascade to N, N with its cascade to L, L alone
metric.counter_kept: a crop keeps its counter when eval/metrics.norm of the text Rubi shows holds [0-9０-９一二三四五六七八九十百千何数幾][ヶヵケ箇][月所年国条] (vocr6-rubi-ship's test, artifacts/vocr6-rubi-ship/kanum_ke.py); every crop's reference holds one
metric.counter_cer: the counter set's CER on the text Rubi shows

a.what: the shipped setting of the LM tier with the shipped counter thresholds and cascade threshold

b.what: the best setting of vocr6-lm's grid on the final blobs, 2-fold cross-validated as #127
b.options: S and N: 352 settings x 3 cascade thresholds = 1,056; L (no cascade): 352
b.why_gate_8000: vocr6-lm's VOCR6-logits grid also held gate 2000 / 4000 nats. Those are below the shipped counter re-decode's tau (6 nats) and at or below its open (4 nats); docs/counters.md requires both strictly below the LM's gate (else an edited frame's moved top-1 leaves the candidates and its old logit is read as the blank's, which undoes the edit). Such a setting would need the counter thresholds changed with it, which this round does not test, so it is not selectable. vocr6-lm's report found that gate-4000 in-sample choices did not survive its cross-validation

c.what: the counter re-decode thresholds at the LM tier's shipped setting and cascade threshold, 2-fold cross-validated
c.note: tau 8000 equals the shipped gate (8000): only an edit costing exactly the gate is affected (docs/counters.md's 'strictly below'); kept in the grid as the task registers it, and the counter set guards it

selection.folds: eval/vocr6_lm.fold_of: the low bit of sha256(cluster id) (VNs for dev, titles for hval), #127's folds
selection.choice: per fold, the option minimising the objective over that fold's units; each fold's units are then scored with the other fold's choice (cross-validated errors); the in-sample choice (all units) is what would ship
selection.ties: the first minimum in option order: the shipped option first (arm b: the shipped setting at the shipped cascade threshold; arm c: 6000 / 4000), then grid order (configs in eval/vocr6_lm.grid_configs order x cascade thresholds as listed; tau-major cells)

intervals: paired cluster bootstrap, 10,000 resamples: eval/vocr6_lm.compare (each part resampled on its own clusters with its seed: tv 0, dn 1, wd 2, hp 3, hc 4; dev score and objective combine the parts' replicates) for the real parts; the counter set over its 189 source lines, seed 5. 'Resolved better': the 95% interval of (arm - shipped) entirely below 0; 'resolved worse': entirely above 0 (the kept share: entirely below 0)

rule.per: each job tier (S + cascade, N + cascade, L) and each LM tier (500k, 1000k, 2000k, 4000k), separately: a change only where it passes
rule.pass: an arm (b or c) passes iff (1) its cross-validated objective is resolved better than the shipped setting's; (2) none of hp, hc and the dev score is resolved worse (cross-validated); (3) on the counter set, the setting that would ship (the in-sample choice) is not resolved worse in CER and its kept share is not resolved lower; (4) it is admissible: the counter thresholds at most the LM gate, and the decoder workspace of the job's models (the tier and its cascade tier) at most Rubi's VJO_VOCR_LM_WS_BYTES
rule.both: if b and c both pass at a tier, the one with the lower cross-validated objective difference (point) changes (b on a tie); the other is reported, not adopted (their combination is not tested)
rule.ships: a passing arm's in-sample choice (setting, cascade threshold, counter thresholds) for that job tier and LM tier; Rubi would carry it per job tier (the job's primary decode and its cascade's decode), told to vocr6-rubi-ship

deviations_from_the_task_prompt: arm b's gate is fixed at 8000 (why_gate_8000)

hval is read by a recognizer that did not train on it (blobs.hval_reader): a stage-4b blob was trained on the hval pages, so its own hval reads would measure memorised pages; its own hval numbers are reported, not used

the dev units and the counter set are decoded with the shipped LM blobs (what Rubi runs; vocr6-lead's stages.4 amendment 3), hval with the screening builds; #127 decoded dev with the screening builds too
arm b's options include the cascade thresholds 500 / 600 / 700 (#127's grid); the rule asks for a pass at each tier separately, as the task's 'a change only for tiers where it passes'
when b and c both pass, one changes (rule.both)
reports: per job tier and LM tier: greedy, shipped, b's cross-validated and in-sample scores (tv, dn, wd, hc, hp, dev score, objective), every comparison with its interval, the choices (folds and in-sample), the rule's clauses, the decision
the counter set's kept count and CER for every arm: the shipped setting, b's in-sample and fold choices, every cell of c (and its comparison with the shipped)
hc and hp by platform (Vita, PSP), names (tv, dn) at the shipped setting and b's in-sample choice; no-cascade scores at the shipped setting
the counter re-decode's edit counts at the shipped thresholds per tier
the final blobs' own hval reads (for 4b blobs) at the shipped setting and b's in-sample choice (report only)
continuity: vocr6-rubi-ship's VOCR5-N counter numbers (3,104 / 3,015 kept; 1,847 / 1,936 errors) reproduced by this harness
